answer.reason: Paul's preaching in its synagogue and the pursuit of him by its Jews are events that belong to the place.

clauses.english: was where Paul reasoned from the scriptures in the synagogue three sabbath days
clauses.quote: three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures

clauses.english: had Jews who followed Paul to Berea and stirred up the people
clauses.quote: they came thither also, and stirred up the people

doubts: ACT 17:11, ACT 20:4, ACT 27:2, PHP 4:16, 1TH 1:1, 2TH 1:1 and 2TI 4:10 only compare, list, address or name people tied to the place, so they were left out.
ACT 17:2-3 are context verses, used for the synagogue clause alongside the marked ACT 17:1.
